fusions.name: Find the Gaps
fusions.desc: Looses 4 stings, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hive Lance
fusions.desc: Launches a barbed lance that deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Sundered] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Swarm Shell
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 16 damage, up to 4 blows, for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 6%. While it holds, a swarm escort strikes your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tireless Under Fire
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they spend at once and you move and attack 5% faster per stack (23% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
